newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE contract puts back in demand.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE contract puts back in demand.

text.p: Dutch investors took out a little protection against a market downturn on Monday as the number of puts traded on the European Option Exchange's flagship EOE contract outweighed calls.
Dominating trade as usual, EOE put options outnumbered calls by around 14,000 to 11,000, reflecting increasing investor jitters as the underlying market approached the 600 point level.

Royal Dutch was also active and here calls were favoured as private investors looked to benefit from any further upside potential in the share price. Total EOE turnover was high at over 150,000 contracts. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
